build_MidasNet_model: build a MidasNet model for monocular depth estimation using resnext101_wsl backbone and 256 features
run_MidasNet_forward: run a forward pass through MidasNet to predict depth from an input image tensor
create_MidasNet_with_weights: create a MidasNet instance that loads pretrained weights from a specified checkpoint file path
review_MidasNet_forward: review the MidasNet forward pass that extracts multi-scale features through four refinement stages
test_MidasNet_load: test the BaseModel load method that loads model state dict from a saved checkpoint file
